//waves: 50-wave arc (Iteration 3, Lane A, D53). Waves 1-25 are fixed-count, 26-50 are timed (duration > 0 ignores count). Waves 10/20/30/40/50 are boss waves (flag parsed now, consumed by BossSystem). Generated from a linear formula so pressure is monotone by construction: count and duration never fall, spawn_interval never rises, hp_mult and speed_mult never fall. Flatter than the old 20-wave table on purpose (#13) — wave 1 is 10 @0.50s where it used to be 12 @0.45s — so the every-5th-wave shop can keep up. PROVISIONAL: unplayed.
//difficulties: Selectable run difficulties (Phase B, D50). Index 0 is the default. Every field is enemy-side on purpose: Hard must not make the player's economy harsher. type_lookahead pulls each wave's enemy roster forward by N waves. PROVISIONAL.
//ships: Selectable ships (Lane F, D82). A ship is a variant of the player block's sidecar/idle_clip/weapon, overlaid onto PlayerConfig at run start. unlock_score is compared against the LIFETIME score in saves/meta.json; 0 = always available. Purple is a gatling: 12/s x 6 dmg = 72 DPS against Standard's 4/s x 20 = 80, i.e. 3x the cadence for 90% of the sustained damage. PROVISIONAL and unplayed. Purple reuses the standard drone art for now (D83).
//economy: Currency/key drop tuning (Gameplay Phase 2). Drop counts are inclusive bounds on a uniform roll; pickup_size doubles as the collection-radius basis.
//shop: PROVISIONAL PRICES — not yet validated against a real credits-per-wave curve (handoff-phase-3.md §8). price_growth compounds per repeat purchase. Row order is the ShipState.upg_counts slot order: re-price or rename freely, re-ordering re-labels existing purchases.

shop.//gear: PROVISIONAL PRICES, same caveat as the upgrades above and for the same reason: no full run has been played, so these are anchored to the upgrade rows rather than to a measured credits-per-wave curve. Uniform within each list on purpose — one slot each, so the choice should be about the effect, not the cost. `effect` maps to the fixed ids in player_components.hpp (item_ids / consumable_ids), NOT to row order; re-order these freely.

//iteration3: Iteration-3 scaffolding (D51). Each block below is OWNED BY ONE LANE and every value here is an inert default: the game plays exactly as it did before iteration 3 until the owning lane fills its block in. Do not let two lanes edit the same block.
//sustain: Lane B / note #10 - periodic health & shield pickups (D56). interval 0 = feature off. Placement walks a golden-angle spiral, not an RNG stream, so a run replays identically.
//dash: Lane B / note #5 - thruster dash. Damage is dealt to every enemy the dash passes through.
//minimap: Lane B / note #7 - arena minimap (D58). x/y/size are in the 800x600 design canvas and are the ONE authority for the map's geometry: MinimapSystem writes them over the authored rect of the 'minimap_frame' panel on the gameplay screen. max_blips is a hard cap; the overflow is logged, never dropped silently.
//specialty: Lane D / notes #3 + #9 (D67). Two cadences over the spawn counter, not RNG: every_n_spawns injects the live arena's specialty unit, moon_every_n_spawns injects one unlocked shooter (a type with first_wave > 0). by_arena maps an arena NAME to an enemy_types NAME - names, not indices, because the two lists are authored by different lanes. tier2_* is what makes the second pass over the same four themes (waves 26-50) harder. PROVISIONAL: unplayed.
//boss: Lane D / note #4 - the every-10th-wave boss. health_growth compounds per appearance; the boss is themed to whichever arena is live and borrows that arena's specialty attack. final_* is the wave-50 fight, which is a different fight rather than a bigger one. shift_hp_frac is the wave-50 mid-fight arena shift, which is NOT wired yet - see the SEAM comment in boss_system.cpp. PROVISIONAL: unplayed.
//actives: Lane D - boss-reward active items, offered on the boss_reward screen and fired with E. All three sit on the 30s cooldown the design note fixes. `effect` is the dispatch key (D26): never a row index. repulsor_field auto-fires below 20% hull instead of on the key. PROVISIONAL: unplayed.
//ui: UI & menu layer (Option-040 port). Rects are authored in the 800x600 design canvas; ui_canvas_transform letterboxes them onto the live window.

widgets.//: Lane C (D61): the clickable shop. ShopSystem resolves every named widget through ui.widget_id.<name> and rewrites label_text/rect each frame; this block owns layout and style only. The on_click_fn names are pinned by CPP/game/tests/unit/test_shop_screen.cpp.
widgets.name: shop_panel

widgets.//: Tooltip: authored once, then repositioned and rewritten on hover. Collapsed to a zero-size rect with empty text when nothing is hovered - UIElement has no visibility flag and adding one would be an engine change.
widgets.name: shop_tip_panel

widgets.//: Lane F (D82): ship selector AND lock readout, deliberately one widget. main.cpp rewrites its label every title frame: 'SHIP: <name>' with the button style while more than one ship is unlocked (a click cycles), or '<name>: <n> pts' in the flat subtitle style while every other ship is locked (a click does nothing, because a locked ship is never selectable).
widgets.name: menu_ship

widgets.label_text: Arrows move, mouse aims, hold fire. SPACE = Normal.

widgets.//: Lane K (D100): resume a run saved from the pause menu. Sits below the panel because the panel is full. main.cpp rewrites it every title frame: a CONTINUE button naming the wave and difficulty when saves/run.json holds a usable run, or an empty flat label when it does not - UIElement has no visibility flag, so an inert widget is how 'hidden' is spelled here (the menu_ship precedent, D82).
widgets.name: menu_continue

widgets.label_text: Spend your credits, or push on.

widgets.//: Lane K (D100): save & quit mid-run. main.cpp rewrites label_text to SAVED / SAVE FAILED on click and back to SAVE each time the pause screen opens. Writes saves/run.json, which the title screen's menu_continue widget then offers.
widgets.name: pause_save

boss_reward.//: Lane D (D71): the boss-kill reward. BossSystem rewrites reward_0/1/2's label_text from the `actives` block every time it pushes this screen (the menu_ship pattern), so the offer can change per boss without a second screen. The click fns are matched as string literals in boss_system.cpp - test_boss.cpp pins the pair.

widgets.label_text: Salvage one active system.  E fires it.
